description: Implement mo attach CLI command for real-time agent monitoring via SSE

tasks.title: Implement SSE client parser
tasks.description: Create a simple SSE client using Node.js built-in http module. It should: (1) Connect to a URL via http.get, (2) Parse SSE format (event: and data: lines), (3) Emit parsed events via callback, (4) Handle connection errors and close. This is a utility function, not a class.
acceptanceCriteria: Function connectSSE(url, { onEvent, onError, onClose }) implemented
Correctly parses event: and data: lines
tasks.notes: SSE format: lines starting with 'event:' set event type, lines starting with 'data:' set data, empty line dispatches. Keep it simple.

tasks.title: Implement event formatter
tasks.description: Create a formatter function that takes an SSE event (type + parsed JSON data) and returns a formatted string with timestamp, symbol, event description, and issue info. Use chalk for coloring.
acceptanceCriteria: Each event type has a distinct color and symbol

agent_started: green, agent_completed: green, agent_paused: yellow, agent_error: red, stage_changed: cyan, comment_added: white, approval_requested: yellow, question_asked: yellow, question_answered: green
tasks.notes: Don't use emoji. Use ASCII symbols: >>, ->, ##, ||, ok, !!.

tasks.title: Implement mo attach command
tasks.description: Create cli/commands/attach.ts with setupAttachCommand(program). Command options: --project <name> (optional, defaults to current project), --follow (auto-reconnect on disconnect). The command should: call requireServer(), resolve project ID if --project specified, build SSE URL with projectId filter, connect and print events, handle SIGINT for graceful detach.
acceptanceCriteria: mo attach command registered in Commander program
mo attach --project myapp filters by project
mo attach --follow reconnects on disconnect with 2s delay
Server not running shows friendly error
tasks.notes: Follow the pattern of existing command files (issue.ts, project.ts). Register in cli/index.ts.

tasks.title: Verify build and manual test
tasks.description: Build, typecheck, and manual test: start server, run mo attach in another terminal, start an issue, verify events appear in attach output.
acceptanceCriteria: mo attach connects and displays events
tasks.notes: The manual test is straightforward — just run mo attach alongside a running agent.
